steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Which sprite should the cameraFollowSprite function be set to follow?


Solution:

null should be changed to squirrel in the sprite parameter of the cameraFollowSprite function.


Ask the ninja:

❓What code should be used to place the Enemy sprite on a random enemyTile asset?


Solution:

img should be replaced with assets.tile in the placeOnRandomTile function.


Ask the ninja:

❓ Which tile should the tile parameter in the placeOnRandomTile function be set to for the Food sprite?


Solution:

The tile parameter in the Food sprite’s placeOnRandomTile function should be changed to assets.tile`foodTile`

﻿
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working tilemap project!


The Player sprite should always be in view on screen.


The Enemy sprite should spawn on a random enemyTile when the project begins.


Food sprites should spawn on a different tile than the Enemy sprites.


Use the functions in the code menu, the debug tool, and the code completion tool to create a working version of this tilemap project!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using the Assets menu to create and manage assets in a project, including tilemaps. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: Asset Management

badges.title: Art Re-Collecting
